item.title: Austin home prices drop $27K, improving housing affordability
item.description: Austin home prices have dropped by nearly $27,000 over the past year, making it the fourth most affordable city in the US for local buyers.

item.title: Nationwide contest offers $4,000 for best sports proposal
item.description: The Action Network is hosting a contest to award $4,000 for the most creative marriage proposal at a live sporting event in February 2026, with entries being judged on creativity, emotional impact, and relevance to the sports setting.

item.title: Actor Robert Duvall dies at 95, wife announces
item.description: He died "peacefully at home, surrounded by love and comfort."

item.title: Lake Texoma's poor water quality raises concerns, study shows
item.description: Lake Texoma ranked as one of the least clean major lakes in the United States, with several concerning measurements.

item.title: Golden Corral brings back all-you-can-eat shrimp & steak deal
item.description: Golden Corral has announced the return of its All-You-Can-Eat Butterfly Shrimp & Steak promotion for a limited time.

item.title: Arlington Museum of Art unveils IndyCar exhibit
item.description: The Arlington Museum of Art has unveiled its latest exhibit, Chasing Victory: An IndyCar Exhibition, featuring race cars from the 20th century, to educate fans ahead of the Java House Grand Prix of Arlington from March 13-15.

item.title: Cook Dad Cook: Celebrity judges and fatherhood insights on CW33
item.description: Cook Dad Cook is a new show on CW33 featuring three dads, some with cooking experience and some without, who are given a recipe and judged by a celebrity guest, with the real heart of the show coming from the "Let Him Cook" reflection moment where the dads share laughs, insights, and life lessons.

item.title: Corner Bakery Cafe offers $2 muffins for National Muffin Day
item.description: Corner Bakery Cafe is offering muffins for $2 on February 20th in celebration of National Muffin Day, with a selection of flavors including Blueberry, Chocolate, Cinnamon Crumb, Cranberry Orange, Banana, Pumpkin and Pumpkin Cheesecake.

item.title: Recall of peanut butter products distributed in Texas, 40 states categorized as 'Class II' by the FDA
item.description: A Class II recall "may cause temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences," according to the FDA.

item.title: Get the Spring Break villa experience at Ritz-Carlton Dallas
item.description: The Ritz-Carlton Dallas, Las Colinas is offering family-oriented activities and lodging packages throughout March for spring break.
